title: Physics Laboratory 2
objectives:
The objective of this lab is to allow students to devise simple logic circuits, hence giving them an opportunity to
reinforce the theoretical concepts taught in the course “Electronics III”.
syllabus: The experiments cover relevant topics prescribed in the syllabus.
textbooks:
Hugh D. Young, Roger A. Freedman, A. Lewis Ford, "Sears and Zemansky's university physics:
with modern physics" (13th ed.), Addison-Wesley, 2012.
David Halliday, Robert Resnick, Jearl Walker, "Fundamentals of physics" (9th ed), John Wiley &
Sons, Inc., 2011.
3. Paul M. Fishbane, Stephen G. Gasiorowicz, Stephen T. Thornton, "Physics: For Scientists and
Engineers with Modern Physics" (3rd ed.), Pearson Prentice Hall, 2005 .
